Je m'appelle Camille. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to call'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'appelé').

examples.text: Appelle Clémentine. Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir ce soir.
examples.trans: Call Clémentine. Tell her I can't come tonight.
